resume: After a separation: insure the new home before you get the keys, notify the old home's insurer, cancel at no cost and check that the children remain covered.
aQuoiCaSert: When you leave the family home, you need both to deal with the old home insurance (assurance habitation) contract and to insure the new home. A tenant must at least be insured against tenant's risks (risques locatifs). It is also the time to check your civil liability cover (responsabilité civile), often included in the home insurance contract, which covers damage caused by the children. In Mayotte, unwritten leases are common: a written lease protects both parties.
quiEstConcerne: The parent who moves after a separation, whether a tenant or an owner.
The parent who stays in the home and needs to adapt the contract.
Both parents, to check that the children have civil liability cover at each parent's home.
aSavoir: Tenant: insurance against tenant's risks (fire, explosion, water damage) is compulsory. Give the certificate to the landlord when you get the keys, then every year if they ask for it.
Moving: notify your insurer before you leave or at the latest within 15 days after leaving the home, by registered letter.

Cancellation because of a move: possible if the change of home alters the insured risks, no later than 3 months after leaving. The contract ends 1 month after the insurer receives the letter, with no cancellation fee.
You can also transfer the contract to the new home if the insurer agrees.
The rules of the law of July 6, 1989 on residential leases, including the tenant's obligation to be insured, were made applicable to Mayotte by a 2012 ordinance (ordonnance), with adaptations.
